caution_findings.evidence_context: Local supplementary files are Nature article HTML/landing captures rather than actual supplementary tables; Table S1-only database rows are not promoted to primary evidence.
Table 1 exists as an image/graphic in XML/PDF; peptide labels/modification context are source-reviewed, but exact sequence strings are not normalized from OCR.
Examples include database Listeria grayi vs primary Table 3 Listeria murrayi for ATCC 25401 and aggregate CAMP/dbAMP rows that cannot be reduced to one primary table row.
